body:
Adds one administrator-approved, consent-based artist import, followed by takeover by an existing externally proved identity. Imported sites and works belong to a temporary Digipomps identity until takeover; consent never becomes a false rights attestation or a sales licence.

- One mandate-only issuance entry, one registry policy (`separateIssuanceVault` / `ownerApprovedIssuance`), one encrypted persistent vault path. Central strict runtime is unchanged.
- Durable single use, 24-hour mandate expiry, seed IDs and previews, consent note, removal and 30-day read-time expiry.
- Takeover binds a fresh external signing challenge to the token hash, import, seed and rights/content attestations. Intermediate transfer hides both stores. Current storage erases the managed key; no artist private key is imported.
- Registry inventory/source evidence/digest golden add the required policy/site; strict-vault denial and manifest-writer tests are not weakened.

Validation: 23 new managed-import tests; final focused local regression 76/76 green, including strict central-vault activation with byte-identical storage, reload, concurrent replay, interruption recovery, storage inspection and real anonymous HTTP requests for the pilot's 5 exhibitions / 14 works. Local preview evidence uses the 13 supplied images. Broad local regression found two existing macOS manifest-writer failures, reproduced on clean origin/main in all three runs; see the operations note. Bounded build, literal gate and suite coverage are required; CI supplies the Linux result.

Operations and threat boundary: `Documentation/Operations/Managed_Artist_Import_2026-09-28.md`. A separate 32-byte vault encryption key and updated owner-signed registry manifest are deployment prerequisites. AP7 is a Cell API; this PR adds no login/takeover GUI. No deployment or production import performed. Claim rejects central/unrelated pre-existing UUID state and grants edits only to the imported records; it cannot broaden authority to older publications or additional site creation.

**Do not merge. Astra must review the issuance vault before merge in a separate job.**

PDD_sindre-import-uten-bruker_2026-09-25
title: AP2–AP5 + AP7: mandate-only managed artist identity and takeover
